def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # --- Заказы, совершённые до seed_time ---
    orders_hist = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time].copy()

    # Информация о доставке известна только если доставка уже произошла до seed_time
    delivered_mask = orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    orders_hist['delivered_on_time'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= orders_hist['order_estimated_delivery_date']).astype(float),
        np.nan
    )
    orders_hist['is_delivered'] = delivered_mask.astype(float)

    # --- Платежи, существовавшие на момент seed_time ---
    pay_cols = ['ts'] if 'ts' in payments.columns else []
    if 'ts' in payments.columns:
        payments_hist = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time].copy()
    else:
        payments_hist = payments.merge(
            orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp']], on='order_id', how='left'
        )
        payments_hist = payments_hist[payments_hist['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    payments_agg = payments_hist.groupby('order_id').agg(
        payment_value_sum=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        payment_installments_mean=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        payment_count=('payment_value', 'count')
    ).reset_index()

    payment_type_counts = payments_hist.groupby(['order_id', 'payment_type']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    payment_type_counts.columns = ['payment_type_' + str(col) for col in payment_type_counts.columns]
    payments_agg = payments_agg.merge(payment_type_counts, on='order_id', how='left')

    # --- Отзывы, созданные до seed_time ---
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    reviews_agg = reviews_hist.groupby('order_id').agg(
        review_score_mean=('review_score', 'mean'),
        review_count=('review_score', 'count')
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Позиции заказов (только исторические заказы) ---
    oi = order_items.merge(
        orders_hist[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'delivered_on_time', 'is_delivered']],
        on='order_id', how='inner'
    )
    oi = oi.merge(payments_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    oi = oi.merge(reviews_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    oi = oi[oi['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]

    grouped = oi.groupby('product_id')

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    # Основные агрегаты (вся история)
    features['total_items'] = grouped.size()
    features['total_unique_orders'] = grouped['order_id'].nunique()
    features['sum_price'] = grouped['price'].sum()
    features['mean_price'] = grouped['price'].mean()
    features['std_price'] = grouped['price'].std()
    features['sum_freight'] = grouped['freight_value'].sum()
    features['mean_freight'] = grouped['freight_value'].mean()
    features['std_freight'] = grouped['freight_value'].std()
    features['unique_sellers'] = grouped['seller_id'].nunique()
    features['items_per_order'] = features['total_items'] / features['total_unique_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Временные признаки
    last_purchase = grouped['order_purchase_timestamp'].max()
    first_purchase = grouped['order_purchase_timestamp'].min()
    features['days_since_last_purchase'] = (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days
    features['days_since_first_purchase'] = (seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days
    features['history_span_days'] = features['days_since_first_purchase'] - features['days_since_last_purchase']

    # Средний интервал между покупками
    oi_sorted = oi.sort_values(['product_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp'])
    oi_sorted['prev_time'] = oi_sorted.groupby('product_id')['order_purchase_timestamp'].shift()
    oi_sorted['diff_days'] = (oi_sorted['order_purchase_timestamp'] - oi_sorted['prev_time']).dt.days
    features['avg_days_between_purchases'] = oi_sorted.groupby('product_id')['diff_days'].mean()

    # Скользящие окна
    for window in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        recent = oi[oi['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= cutoff]
        rg = recent.groupby('product_id')
        features[f'items_last_{window}d'] = rg.size()
        features[f'orders_last_{window}d'] = rg['order_id'].nunique()
        features[f'price_sum_last_{window}d'] = rg['price'].sum()
        features[f'sellers_last_{window}d'] = rg['seller_id'].nunique()
        # тренд: отношение окна к предыдущему окну такой же длины
        prev = oi[(oi['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= cutoff - pd.Timedelta(days=window)) &
                  (oi['order_purchase_timestamp'] < cutoff)]
        prev_orders = prev.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
        cur_orders = features[f'orders_last_{window}d']
        features[f'trend_{window}d'] = cur_orders / (prev_orders + 1)
        features[f'exp_decay_orders_{window}d'] = cur_orders / (window / 30)

    # Отзывы (только созданные до seed_time)
    features['review_score_mean'] = grouped['review_score_mean'].mean()
    features['review_count'] = grouped['review_count'].sum()
    features['review_score_min'] = grouped['review_score_mean'].min()
    features['review_score_max'] = grouped['review_score_mean'].max()

    # Отзывы за последние 90 дней
    review_recent = oi[oi['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    features['review_score_mean_last90'] = review_recent.groupby('product_id')['review_score_mean'].mean()
    features['review_score_min_last90'] = review_recent.groupby('product_id')['review_score_mean'].min()

    # Платежи
    features['payment_value_sum'] = grouped['payment_value_sum'].sum()
    features['payment_installments_mean'] = grouped['payment_installments_mean'].mean()
    features['payment_count'] = grouped['payment_count'].sum()
    for col in payment_type_counts.columns:
        if col in oi.columns:
            features[col] = grouped[col].sum()

    # Доставка (только для заказов, доставленных до seed_time)
    features['delivered_on_time_ratio'] = grouped['delivered_on_time'].mean()
    features['delivered_ratio'] = grouped['is_delivered'].mean()

    # Заполняем пропуски
    features = features.fillna(0)

    return features.reindex(entity_ids)
